newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: McRetail in 25 mln rand Namibia expansion.
newsitem.headline: McRetail in 25 mln rand Namibia expansion.

text.p: McCarthy Retail Ltd said it planned to spend 25 million rand on an expansion drive into Namibia in the next 12 to 18 months.
"By the end of 1997 we will have a network of 20 new stores in Namibia," said Hymie Sibul, an executive director of McRetail and chairman of Prefcor, its retail store arm.

McRetail is already active in the Namibian market having recently bought five Buxmann furniture retail stores, now trading as Beares, for five million rand. It has also opened a 12-million rand Game store in Windhoek.
Sibul said McRetail planned to enter the retail clothing sector by setting up three Guys & Girls stores. The Beares chain would be expanded by 10 new outlets.
McRetail was looking at setting up a holding company for its Namibian operations and may seek a listing on the Namibia Stock Exchange in the years to come.
